a: Nigeria has 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory.
Niger State is among the largest by land area.
Lagos is often called the commercial capital.
Official name: Federal Republic of Nigeria.
The National Assembly is the federal legislature.
Presidential terms are defined by the constitution; verify current rules for legal details.
Nigeria does not use daylight saving time.
Major airports include those serving Lagos and Abuja.
Lagos ports handle a large share of Nigeria's maritime trade.
